# Rob Furze {.hero-name}

I build multiscale computational tools that predict friction and lubrication in
artificial hip-joint bearings — coupling microscale surface physics to
full-joint elastohydrodynamic simulation.

[PhD researcher · EPSRC CDT in Fluid Dynamics · University of Leeds]{.hero-sub}

[Methods & code →](methods/index.qmd){.btn-accent} &nbsp;&nbsp; [Read the research](research.qmd)
:::

[overview]{.eyebrow}

## What you'll find here

The [methods](methods/index.qmd) section collects runnable notebooks that
demonstrate the numerical machinery behind the research —
the Heterogeneous Multiscale Method (HMM), microscale cell problems, and the
macro/micro coupling that drives the full lubrication model. Each one can be
opened and run in the browser via Colab or Binder, or downloaded as a notebook.
